name: eval-coding-agent-harness
description: Evaluates whether a change to a coding-agent skill changes what the agent writes, across several coding-agent hosts.
//: The engines floor is promptfoo's. The Claude Agent SDK is pinned to the version promptfoo 0.124.1 lists.
The Codex CLI is not declared: .devcontainer/install/codex.sh installs a pinned release. promptfoo -> @openai/codex-sdk -> @openai/codex also brings an older one.
TypeScript runs on Node directly by type stripping; typescript is for tsc --noEmit only, and is held below 6.1 by typescript-eslint's peer range. `make check` is the gate.
